title: Assistant Quality Analyst
description:
As an Assistant Quality Analyst, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the highest standards of quality and safety in our food products. You will work closely with our team to implement and maintain quality control processes, analyze data, and drive continuous improvement. Your expertise will contribute to the overall success and reputation of our company in the food industry.
  

* Conduct thorough quality inspections and audits of food products and processes.
* Identify and address any non-conformities or deviations from quality standards.
* Implement and maintain a robust Food Safety Management System (FSMS) in line with industry regulations.
* Analyze and interpret data to identify trends and areas for improvement.
* Develop and implement strategies to enhance product quality and consistency.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with quality goals.
* Provide training and guidance to team members on quality assurance practices.
* Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in food quality and safety.
* Prepare and present quality reports and recommendations to senior management.
* Ensure compliance with relevant food safety regulations and standards.

  

* Minimum 2+ years of experience in the food industry, preferably with oil and organic pulses.
* Graduate in science with a background in Food Technology (B. Tech or equivalent).
* Knowledge of quality and food safety requirements, including FSMS.
* Excellent leadership and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Knowledge of SAP is an asset.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to grasp new concepts quickly.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high standards of quality.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and industry trends.
* A proactive and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Business Analyst – AaravPOS**

**About AaravPOS**  
AaravPOS is a cloud-based Point of Sale (POS) platform designed for salons and businesses. Our platform provides comprehensive business management solutions including appointment management, billing, inventory management, customer management, staff management, online booking, and business reporting. We focus on building scalable, reliable, and user-friendly technology solutions that help businesses streamline their daily operations and improve efficiency.

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Mid-Level Business Analyst to join our growing team at AaravPOS. The ideal candidate has solid hands-on experience gathering requirements, writing user stories, and working within Agile teams to deliver product features. You are comfortable working independently, communicating with stakeholders, and collaborating with developers and designers to bring business solutions to life. You will play an important role in ensuring our platform continues to evolve and serve salons, spas, and barbershops across Canada effectively.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather, document, and analyze business requirements from stakeholders and product owners
* Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Create and maintain process flow diagrams, wireframes, and use case documentation
* Work closely with developers, designers, and QA engineers to ensure requirements are understood and implemented correctly
* Conduct gap analysis to identify opportunities for process and feature improvement
* Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, and stakeholder review meetings
* Support backlog grooming and help prioritize features in collaboration with the product team
* Validate delivered features against business requirements and acceptance criteria
* Document system workflows for modules including appointments, billing, inventory, staff, and reporting
* Support QA teams by contributing to test case development aligned with business requirements
* Assist with user acceptance testing (UAT) and gather feedback for iteration
* Identify and communicate risks, dependencies, and blockers to the team
* Maintain clear and up-to-date project documentation throughout the development lifecycle

**Mandatory Skills**

*1. Requirements Gathering & Documentation*

* Solid experience eliciting, analyzing, and documenting business and functional requirements
* Experience writing user stories, BRDs, FRDs, and process documentation
* Ability to support backlog management and feature prioritization

*2. Process Analysis & Mapping*

* Experience creating process flow diagrams, swimlane diagrams, and use case models
* Ability to identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements

*3. Stakeholder Communication*

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to present information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Comfortable participating in meetings, reviews, and demos

*4. Agile/Scrum*

* Hands-on experience working in Agile/Scrum teams
* Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, Trello, or Notion
* Experience participating in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives

*5. Analytical Thinking*

* Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills
* Ability to analyze information and translate it into clear, actionable requirements

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working on SaaS, POS, CRM, or ERP platforms
* Familiarity with UI/UX concepts and working alongside design teams
* Basic understanding of REST APIs and how backend systems work
* Experience with SQL or basic data querying for reporting purposes
* Knowledge of payment processing, appointment booking, or inventory management systems
* Experience with tools like Figma, Lucidchart, or Miro for documentation and wireframing
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and delivery processes

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst
* Proven experience in a software product or SaaS company
* Strong documentation, communication, and organizational skills
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (preferred)
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across cross-functional teams
* Good understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC)

**What We Are Looking For**

* Someone who takes ownership of assigned requirements and sees them through to delivery
* A clear communicator who can bridge business goals and technical execution
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational and documentation habits
* A collaborative team player who proactively flags issues and finds solutions
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet project deadlines
* Eagerness to understand the salon and beauty industry and contribute to solutions that serve it well

**Why Join AaravPOS?**

* Opportunity to work on a growing cloud-based SaaS POS platform
* Contribute meaningfully to product direction and feature development
* Work on real modules used by businesses across Canada
* Collaborative and supportive working environment
* Professional growth and career development opportunities
* Work with a team focused on building innovative business solutions

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

description:
#### **Job ID**

67658

**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

  

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra-high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening
  
up a world of opportunities by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

  

**Location:** **HSBC Gift City Branch | GIFT IFSC, Gandhinagar, Gujarat**

  

**Role purpose**

* The role will be responsible for establishing and strengthening the data analytics, business intelligence, performance monitoring, and management reporting capabilities for the International Wealth & Premier Banking business at HSBC Gift City Branch.
* The role will be responsible for translating business priorities into trusted data products, management information, customer and campaign insights, and actionable recommendations. The role will work across business, technology, data owners, risk, compliance and other control functions to improve data availability, quality, accessibility and usage.
  

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Data strategy and governance**

* Develop and maintain a practical data and analytics roadmap for IWPB at GIFT City, aligned to business priorities and regulatory requirements.
* Assess data sources, ownership, definitions, availability, quality, refresh frequency and access requirements across banking, deposits, investments, CRM and other authorised systems.
* Partner with technology and data teams to enable approved datasets on GCP, including requirements for ingestion, transformation, storage, access controls and consumption.
* Establish data-quality checks, lineage, documentation and controls covering completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness and reconciliation.

**2. Business intelligence and performance reporting**

* Develop and maintain management dashboards and MI using Power BI or an equivalent BI platform.
* Monitor performance against business plans, budgets, targets and forecasts across customers, deposits, investments, products, revenue and other approved measures.
* Automate recurring reporting and reduce manual spreadsheet-based processes while maintaining appropriate controls and documentation.
* Translate data into clear insights on performance drivers, trends, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.

**3. Customer and portfolio analytics**

* Develop customer analytics frameworks to understand customer profiles, engagement patterns, relationship value, product holdings, balances and business potential.
* Analyse customer segments using permitted attributes, including residency status, customer category, tenure, product usage and customer lifecycle stage.
* Identify opportunities for additional deposits, investment product uptake and broader relationship development, subject to consent, suitability, data permissions and internal policies.
* Provide actionable insights to business leadership and relationship teams to support customer strategy and portfolio growth.

* Evaluate the effectiveness of business campaigns, product propositions, customer engagement initiatives, and distribution strategies.

**4. Advanced analytics, machine learning and generative AI**

* Develop segmentation, propensity, forecasting and other machine-learning models where there is a clear business case and sufficient data quality.
* Use Python, SQL and appropriate analytical tools to automate analysis, identify patterns and improve customer and business decision-making.
* Explore responsible applications of generative AI for analytics productivity, reporting, documentation, insight generation and data-quality investigation, using approved HSBC tools and processes.
* Document model assumptions, validation results, limitations, monitoring requirements and responsible-use considerations, including explainability, fairness, privacy and model governance.
  

**Experience and qualifications:**

* **5–8 years’ experience** in data analytics, business intelligence, customer analytics, performance reporting or data strategy, preferably within banking or financial services.
* Strong hands-on skills in **SQL, Python and Power BI** or an equivalent BI platform, with experience in data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, analysis, automation and dashboard development.
* Practical experience in **machine learning**, including customer segmentation, propensity modelling, forecasting, campaign measurement or model evaluation.
* Experience working across multiple data sources, with a sound understanding of **data quality, data lineage, governance, access controls and validation**.
* Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical analytics solutions and present insights clearly to senior stakeholders.
  

**Pro Tip:** Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

  

**Desirable:**

* Experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery, cloud data warehouses, data pipelines, APIs or related data-engineering concepts.
* Experience using **generative AI** for analytics, reporting, automation or productivity, with an understanding of responsible AI, privacy, explainability and information-security requirements.

**Note:**

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

  

*Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India*

title: Lead Account Analyst – KPO (Accounts & Tenant Collections)

description:
**Company Description**

At Haresh S Kansara & Co, we cater focused needs of Finance, Accounting, Audits, Taxation and Management Consultancy.

Since 1989, we've grown into a multi-branch practice—with a genuine goal of achieving extraordinary results for our clients.

Today we're working better, smarter, and faster than ever—and setting our sights even higher. Most importantly, we're continuing to invest in a diverse team of top talent who fuel each other's passions and curiosity, take risks, try new things, and believe that every new day brings opportunities for growth.

**Job Description**

In a time of unprecedented expansion, we are seeking a **Lead Account Analyst – KPO (Accounts & Tenant Collections)** to join our KPO operations. This is a combined role:

* **60% – Accounts & Analytics:** leading analytics and reporting for KPO accounts (US real estate clients)
* **40% – Tenant Collections:** calling tenants in the United States to remind them of upcoming or overdue rent and to follow up on collections

This is an excellent mid-senior level opportunity for a candidate who thrives in high-energy environments, works well with internal teams, and is confident speaking with US customers over the phone. The position requires technical skills in accounting along with **excellent spoken and listening skills in English**.

Our objective is to work with clients with complete transparency and efficiency. The ideal candidate has strong time-management and communication skills. And we’re here to help you succeed at every step of your journey with us.

**A Day on The Job Looks Like This**

***Accounts & Analytics (60%)***

* Work with large datasets, and organize, clean and analyze data in Excel.
* Use Excel functions (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, IF statements, Charts, Conditional Formatting, etc.) for data processing.
* Prepare reports, dashboards and summaries based on project requirements.
* Communicate findings and updates clearly via email, chat or documentation.
* Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) for data analysis and reporting.
* Work with team members to ensure accurate and timely delivery of reports.

***Tenant Collections (40%)***

* Make outbound calls to tenants in the United States to remind them of rent due dates and follow up on overdue balances.
* Speak with tenants professionally and courteously, and listen carefully to understand their concerns and commitments.
* Record call outcomes, payment promises and follow-up dates accurately in the property management system or tracker.
* Coordinate with the property management team on tenant queries, payment issues and escalations.
* Prepare collection status updates and delinquency reports.

**Qualifications**

Got the skills and experience? Here’s what we’re looking for:

* 1+ years of analytics, accounting or reporting experience with a proven track record of success
* **Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation, and strong listening skills, including understanding US accents – MUST**
* Comfortable making phone calls to US tenants and handling sensitive conversations about rent payments politely and confidently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (formulas, Pivot Tables, data validation, etc.) – MUST
* Prior experience in a US calling, collections, customer service or BPO/KPO process – a strong plus
* Yardi/Timberline (Sage 300 Construction and Real Estate) experience – ideal but not a must
* CA Inter pursuing/cleared – ideal but not a must
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to analyze and interpret data trends
* Ability to work to deadlines and handle repetitive tasks accurately
* Willingness to work shift timings that overlap with US business hours for tenant calls

**Benefits**  
**And here’s our end of the bargain!**

* Expected salary range: 3 to 4.2 Lakhs per Annum
* Generous personal paid time off policy
* Paid holidays on major festivals
* Excellent overtime opportunities
* Professional development and unlimited growth opportunities

**OUR PROMISE TO ALL CANDIDATES**

At Haresh S Kansara & Co, we know our diversity makes us stronger, and when everyone feels included and valued, we all win. We strive to embrace our differences and create an intentionally diverse and inclusive community.

Everyone is selected to become members of the Haresh S Kansara & Co family solely based on skill, merit, and mind-boggling talent—not based on religion, caste, sex, descent, place of birth, gender, marital status.

**If you’re a down-to-earth professional who shares our desire to make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.**

DRC Systems is seeking an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with business and project stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle. As a key link between business and technology, you will clarify expectations, identify gaps and dependencies, and keep stakeholders aligned as requirements evolve.

Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, use cases, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

Act as the day-to-day link between business and technical teams, clarifying requirements and resolving questions promptly.

Collaborate with design, engineering, and QA teams to support solution design, development, and testing.

Review proposed solutions and deliverables to confirm they meet agreed business requirements.

Support user acceptance testing by preparing scenarios, coordinating feedback, tracking issues, and helping stakeholders validate outcomes.

Identify requirement gaps, risks, scope changes, and process improvement opportunities; communicate them to the appropriate stakeholders.

Maintain accurate project documentation, decisions, and action items; contribute to planning and estimation by clarifying scope, complexity, and dependencies.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

4–5 years of experience in a Business Analyst role, preferably in software delivery, IT services, or technology-enabled projects.

Experience managing requirements from discovery through documentation, delivery, and validation.

Strong stakeholder management skills and the confidence to work effectively with business users and technical teams.

title: Brightstar Hospitality - Data Analyst
description:
Talent Formula (http://talentformula.co) is a consulting firm that offers outsourced financial and accounting Human Resources to Chartered Accounting firms worldwide. We currently have a Data Analyst position available with our client, Brightstar Hospitality. This role offers a unique opportunity to be a team member based in India.

**About Client**

Brightstar Hospitality is an award-winning hotel management company operating a growing portfolio on behalf of a range of owners, supported by a central finance function based at our head office. Our motto is people – quality – profit, and it is no accident that people come first. As the group grows, so does the volume, variety and importance of our data, and we are investing in the systems, structure and expertise needed to turn that data into faster, better-informed commercial decisions.

**The Role**

This is a newly created role within central finance, with a group-wide remit spanning finance, revenue management, operations, marketing and people. You will own how data moves through Brightstar, from how it is captured, ingested, validated and structured through to how it is analysed and reported, across three dimensions: data management and architecture; analysis and insight; and automation and AI, principally using Claude.

You will also support the Finance Director in the evaluation and implementation of a new FP&A planning and consolidation platform (Datarails and comparable products are currently under evaluation). The role is not owner-facing, but the colleagues who manage owner relationships will rely on your analysis and reporting. This is a hands-on, build-and-own role, suiting someone with three to four years of practical data management and analysis experience who wants the scope, autonomy and senior-level access to design something properly from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Management, Ingestion and Architecture**

* Own the ingestion of data from hotel and central systems (PMS, RMS, POS, payroll, procurement and the finance ledgers) into a structured, reliable central reporting layer, replacing manual collection with automated data flows.
* Design and maintain the data architecture underpinning group reporting, including the multi-hotel profit and loss database covering prior-year actuals, budget, current-year actuals and forecast at general ledger level, with standardised mapping and chart-of-accounts alignment across entities and properties.
* Establish and run data-quality controls covering completeness, reconciliation to source, exception reporting and validation, and maintain clear documentation of data sources, definitions, transformations and lineage.

**Reporting, Insight and Commercial Analysis**

* Produce and develop the group’s recurring management reporting, KPI dashboards and variance analysis for hotel, central, executive and board audiences, with clear commentary identifying trends, variances, risks and opportunities.
* Build and maintain self-service dashboards, rationalise duplicated reporting, and establish a single version of the truth for each key measure.
* Analyse trading performance across the portfolio, including occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, segmentation, channel mix, length of stay and booking curve, and support rate, demand, competitor and market analysis for revenue meetings.
* Analyse distribution and channel economics including OTA cost of sale, and bring together commercial, operational, payroll and guest-experience data to analyse profitability and productivity at property, department and segment level.

**Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting**

* Build and maintain the models and driver frameworks used across the group for budgeting and forecasting, designed so that finance, operations and commercial colleagues can work in them directly.
* Develop and maintain the underlying assumption and driver logic for demand, rate, payroll, cost inflation and recharges, with centralised, transparent assumptions, and build scenario and sensitivity analysis to support decision-making.
* Support the annual budget cycle and periodic reforecasting, and support the Finance Director on the new FP&A platform, including data mapping, dimension and hierarchy design, integration, testing and user onboarding.

**AI, Automation and Data Governance**

* Apply AI tooling, principally Claude, to accelerate and improve recurring analysis, reporting and data preparation, and build repeatable AI workflows such as structured projects, prompt libraries and documented instructions that produce consistent, auditable results.
* Configure and maintain the integrations that give AI tooling controlled access to our data, including the Microsoft 365 and SharePoint environment and the finance ledgers.
* Evaluate new tooling and techniques, run proportionate pilots, and act as the practical enabler for AI adoption, training colleagues and building internal capability rather than concentrating it in one person.
* Co-own the group’s data and AI governance framework with the Finance Director, covering ownership, definitions, access, retention and change control, ensuring personal data is handled in line with UK GDPR, access is segregated appropriately between properties, entities and owners, and card and payment data is excluded from analytical environments in line with PCI DSS.

**Collaboration and Business Partnering**

* Act as the central point of contact for data and analysis across finance, revenue management, operations, marketing and people, supporting colleagues who manage owner relationships and working with General Managers to improve data capture at source.
* Present findings clearly and confidently to audiences who are not data specialists, including at executive and board level, and challenge constructively when the data does not support the conclusion being drawn.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Three to four years’ practical experience in a data management, analytics or business intelligence role, with demonstrable ownership of end-to-end delivery.
* Proven experience building and maintaining data ingestion and reporting processes across multiple source systems, including reconciliation and data-quality control.
* Advanced Excel, including formula-driven modelling with centralised assumptions; working knowledge of SQL; and experience with a modern visualisation platform, ideally Power BI.
* Genuine, practical experience applying AI tooling to real analytical or reporting work, with a clear view of where it adds value and where it does not.
* Strong commercial and financial literacy, with confidence in a profit and loss account, margin, variance and driver-based analysis.
* Ability to translate an ambiguous business question into a defined analytical task, and to communicate the answer clearly to a non-technical audience.
* High attention to detail, sound judgement and discretion with confidential and personal data; self-directed and comfortable operating as the sole dedicated data specialist.

**Desirable**

* Experience in hospitality, hotels or another multi-entity, multi-site environment, and familiarity with hotel commercial metrics and revenue management concepts (ADR, RevPAR, segmentation, channel mix, booking curve).
* Exposure to USALI as a reporting framework, or experience standardising reporting across inconsistently structured entities.
* Experience implementing or working within an FP&A planning and consolidation platform, for example Datarails, Vena, Anaplan, Board or Jedox.
* Experience with Xero or another accounting platform in a multi-entity structure, with PMS or RMS data, and with Python or a comparable scripting language for data preparation.
* Experience of data governance, UK GDPR in practice or AI acceptable-use policy, and a relevant degree or professional qualification in a data, finance or analytical discipline.

**What We Offer**

* A genuinely broad, newly created role with the scope to design and own the group’s data and reporting architecture from the ground up.
* Direct reporting line to the Finance Director, with regular exposure to the executive team and board, and meaningful involvement in the selection and implementation of a new FP&A platform.
* An employer actively investing in AI capability, with the tooling, licences and mandate to use it properly.
* Hybrid working from our Birmingham office, with training, development and study support. [Funded Level 6 or Level 7 apprenticeship route available, to be confirmed with HR.]
* Staff and friends-and-family discounts across the group, plus wellbeing support, and a competitive salary and benefits package. [Additional benefits to be confirmed.]
* A supportive, people-first culture where curiosity, initiative and constructive challenge are genuinely valued.

**How to apply?**

To be considered for this role, you must complete 3 steps:

1. Apply to this job on Naukri and upload your resume

2. Complete the Skills Tests for this role. You must follow the link below and complete the testing assessments. The first assessment is a Skills Test, to assess your technical ability and numerical reasoning.

3. Complete the Psychometric Test for this role

If you successfully clear the Skills Test, you will be redirected to a Psychometric Test to assess how you think and make decisions.

To complete these tests, you must go to https://es.peoplogicaskills.com/es/quiz?testId=574433ed97b4f2f5 https://es.peoplogicaskills.com/es/quiz?testId=4adaf2a3a69c8e07and complete the assessments.

**If you do not complete the assessments, then you will not be considered for the role.**
